name: Ranged Blast
body:
Element(s): universal; Type form infusion; Level 1; Burn 1

Associated Blasts: any

Saving Throw: none

You have learned to use your elemental weapon as a ranged attack. You can make a ranged attack with your kinetic blast with a range of up to 30 feet.
